sourceText:
Quick & Delicious Apple Fritters
By: Marcia Mackesy
Published: Sunday, May 23, 2010 - 9:40am

Ingredients




3 apples (gala, fuji or any "hard" fleshed apples work best)
2 cups pancake mix
1/2 cup sugar
2 tablespoons cinnamon
1/2 cup milk (approximately)
brown sugar or icing sugar for sprinkling
oil for cooking

Preparation

1 Wash, core and slice apples horizontally for a 1/2 inch slice. 2 Mix pancake, sugar and cinnamon in a bowl. 3 Add milk slowly to dry ingredients.  Only add enough milk to make a thick, doughy mixture. 4 Dredge apples in pancake mixture so that the apples are well covered. 5 Fry apples in oil, flipping them & waiting until they are golden brown OR for healthy alternative, lay apple fritters on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees until golden brown. 6 Once fritters are done sprinkle with brown sugar or icing sugar to taste.

About


Makes a great dessert when served with ice cream.
